name: hotspot-to-rq
description: Choose broad project directions or assess completed experiments through context-isolated Socratic debate and session validation.

interface.shortDescription: Choose directions or assess completed experiments.
interface.longDescription: Scans project evidence to present a broad direction map for selection, or audits an existing experimental direction through evidence inventory, result validation, external positioning, Socratic debate, and a continue/repair/pivot/stop decision.
interface.defaultPrompt: Evaluate my existing experiments before recommending whether to continue, repair, pivot, or stop.
